phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, both sides ground-oriented, heavy economy, moderate production, light tech. Opponent shows Queen cues, pressure possible.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop ground forces and economy while keeping defense ready; adapt to pressure or tech shifts.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army, increase economy, continue tech, maintain defense and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy at the expense of early defense; ensure sufficient army to respond to pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, both sides ground, heavy economy, moderate production, light tech. Zergling and Queen cues visible.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent techs up or shows air presence.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground strength and economy; watch for tech or air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground, maintain economy, production, tech, and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Ground Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while expanding; maintain a balanced ground force.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, both sides ground, heavy economy, heavy production, moderate tech. Zergling and Queen cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent techs to air or shows heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Sustain ground macro; adapt to air threats or pressure as needed.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground strength, economy, production, tech, and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Macro
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech or air without confirming opponent's air presence; keep ground defense solid.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, opponent ground with heavy air presence, heavy economy, heavy production, heavy tech. Zergling, Mutalisk, Roach, Queen cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent commits to air or ground.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Bolster defenses against air while continuing ground development; adapt to opponent's commitment.
phase_policies.target: Increase defense, economy, continue production and tech, strengthen ground.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Defense
phase_policies.veto: Do not ignore air threats; ensure anti-air capabilities while maintaining ground strength.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
